Description: Malicious instructions embedded in citizen complaints may manipulate AI responses.
Potential_Impact: Unauthorized information disclosure or incorrect responses.
NIC_Mitigation: Treat complaint text as untrusted input, use secure prompts, restrict access and validate AI outputs.

Description: AI may produce unfair predictions for certain languages, regions or citizen groups.
Potential_Impact: Incorrect grievance classification and unequal service delivery.
NIC_Mitigation: Use diverse training data, test performance across languages and regions, conduct regular audits and provide human review.
